sources.summary: This week on Dezeen, we reported on the demolition of a never-opened concert hall by Studio Fuksas, which is now underway in Tbilisi, Georgia. Footage shared by local news organisation TV Pirveli captured scale-like cladding being removed from the tube-shaped Rike Concert Hall, which has sat unopened since 2012.
